description: This file contains unit tests for the AttendanceRecordAPI within the OrangeHRM project. It tests retrieval, updating, and permission-related functionalities for attendance records via API endpoints.

classes.name: AttendanceRecordAPITest
classes.description: PHPunit test class for testing the AttendanceRecordAPI endpoints and related permissions.

methods.name: testGetOne
methods.description: Tests retrieving a single attendance record via API.

methods.name: testUpdate
methods.description: Tests updating an attendance record via API.

methods.name: enableUserCanModifyAttendancePreHook
methods.description: Sets up workflow states allowing user modification of attendance records.

methods.name: enableSupervisorCanModifyAttendancePreHook
methods.description: Sets up workflow states allowing supervisor modification of attendance records.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Tests that delete operation is not implemented for attendance records.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Tests the validation rules for delete operation, expected to raise not implemented exception.
